gateway_demo_before_generation_guard.source: Local laptop gateway connected to a second local synthetic server

final_generation_aware_gateway_demo.source: Current local laptop gateway connected to its own synthetic source for transport verification

verification_limits: Both source servers generated synthetic frames; no physical Raspberry Pi network or RealSense camera was tested.
No serial port, motor command, firmware upload, or physical rover motion was used.
Elapsed values measure this short warmed-up worker loop and are not a physical rover frame-rate guarantee.
Predictions on synthetic frames do not establish person, fire, smoke, or candle accuracy.
Gateway generation protection was also checked after reconnect; the prior source generation was rejected with HTTP 409.
